chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics
chapterIntro: This chapter is now stored as a standalone data file. The page auto-renders the definition, core criteria, grouped sections, and one-by-one paper cards, so future updates only require editing this JSON.
definition: “AI agents and synthetic subjects in experimental economics” refers to embedding AI systems—especially large-language-model agents—into controlled experimental-economic settings with explicit rules, treatments, and incentive structures, either as substitute or supplementary participants, or as opponents, market participants, and environment components.

The key criterion is not merely that AI is used, but that the design includes an explicit protocol, identifiable treatment variation, payoff or incentive-compatible decision structure, and comparative evaluation against human data, theory, or institutional baselines.
criteria: Comparison against human data, theory, or institutional baselines

papers.title: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?
papers.venue: NBER Working Paper 31122; conference presentation at AEA 2025
papers.publicationStatus: NBER Working Paper 31122; conference presentation at AEA 2025
papers.subtheme: 模拟经济代理 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?. NBER Working Paper 31122; conference presentation at AEA 2025.
papers.abstract: The paper argues that LLMs can be treated as implicit computational models of humans—a 'Homo silicus'. It demonstrates this by running LLM-based versions of classic behavioral-economics experiments and shows broadly qualitative alignment with the original human findings, while also highlighting how simulation can cheaply generate new variations for later human testing.
papers.abstractZh: 文章提出将大语言模型视为一种“隐式的人类计算模型”（Homo silicus），像经济学中的 homo economicus 一样赋予其禀赋、信息与偏好，再放入经济情景中进行模拟。作者展示了该方法能够在定性上复现若干经典实验经济学现象，而与人类结果不一致的地方本身也可反过来生成新的研究假设。

papers.title: Out of One, Many: Using Language Models to Simulate Human Samples
papers.subtheme: 合成样本 / synthetic subjects
papers.citation: Out of One, Many: Using Language Models to Simulate Human Samples. Political Analysis, 31(3).
papers.abstract: A foundational paper for ‘silicon samples’. It argues that conditioned language models can serve as proxies for particular human subpopulations and introduces the idea of ‘algorithmic fidelity’—the extent to which appropriately conditioned models match subgroup response distributions.
papers.abstractZh: 这是“silicon samples（硅样本）”方向的奠基性工作。文章认为，经过适当条件化后的语言模型，可以作为特定人类子群体的代理，并提出“algorithmic fidelity（算法保真度）”概念，用来衡量模型对不同群体反应分布的拟合程度。

papers.title: AITurk: Using ChatGPT for Social Science Research
papers.subtheme: AI辅助预实验 / 可复制性评估
papers.citation: AITurk: Using ChatGPT for Social Science Research. SSRN / PsyArXiv-style working paper.
papers.abstract: This study evaluates whether ChatGPT can mimic responses from online crowdsourcing participants. By replicating 22 recent studies, the authors report that AI-generated samples reproduce most main findings while reducing time and monetary cost dramatically, and they frame the system as useful for pilot testing and replication assessment rather than as a full replacement for human subjects.
papers.abstractZh: 该研究考察 ChatGPT 能否模拟在线众包受试者（如 MTurk、Prolific）并复现近期社会科学实验结果。作者报告其在方向性发现上具有较高复现率，并将 AITurk 定位为一种低成本、快速的预研究与可重复性筛查工具，而非对人类样本的完全替代。

papers.title: GPT-Language-based Experimental Economics System (GLEES)
papers.subtheme: 经济实验平台 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: GPT-Language-based Experimental Economics System (GLEES). SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: GLEES introduces a platform for conducting economic experiments with AI agents powered by LLMs. The paper is less about one single behavioral result and more about infrastructure: how to instantiate agents, run exploratory social-preference experiments, and turn LLMs into reusable experimental participants within a controlled economics setting.
papers.abstractZh: GLEES 提出了一套利用 LLM 代理开展经济实验的平台化框架。本文重点不在某一个具体行为结论，而在于基础设施建设：如何实例化代理、运行探索性的社会偏好实验，并把 LLM 转化为可在受控经济实验环境中重复调用的“实验参与者”。

papers.title: Playing games with GPT: What can we learn about a large language model from canonical strategic games?
papers.subtheme: 经典经济博弈 / 早期证据
papers.citation: Playing games with GPT: What can we learn about a large language model from canonical strategic games?. Economics Bulletin, 44(1).
papers.abstract: An early economics paper comparing GPT-3.5 with human behavior in the dictator game and prisoner's dilemma. It finds relatively strong fairness and cooperation in GPT, sometimes even exceeding human levels, illustrating both the promise and the calibration problem of LLM subjects.
papers.abstractZh: 这是经济学领域较早直接比较 GPT-3.5 与人类在独裁者博弈和囚徒困境中行为差异的论文。结果显示 GPT 具有较强的公平与合作倾向，某些情况下甚至高于人类，这同时体现了 LLM 受试者的潜力与“校准偏差”问题。

papers.title: Demand for Fairness in the Ultimatum Game: Human vs. LLM Responders
papers.subtheme: 最后通牒博弈 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: Demand for Fairness in the Ultimatum Game: Human vs. LLM Responders. SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: The paper studies how several LLMs respond as responders in the Ultimatum Game under different stake sizes, and compares those responses with human patterns. It finds both similarities and systematic differences, especially in stake sensitivity and rejection behavior, making it a clean example of LLMs used as synthetic participants in an economic game.
papers.abstractZh: 本文考察多个 LLM 在最后通牒博弈中作为回应者时，对不同赌注规模的反应，并将其与人类受试者的模式进行比较。结果表明，LLM 与人类既有相似性，也存在系统差异，尤其体现在对赌注变化的敏感度与拒绝行为上，是“LLM 作为经济博弈中的合成受试者”的典型案例。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Playing Prisoner's Dilemma Games with a Large Language Model
papers.subtheme: 囚徒困境 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: Playing Prisoner's Dilemma Games with a Large Language Model. SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: This paper conducts a laboratory-style Prisoner’s Dilemma experiment using ChatGPT as the decision maker and belief reporter. By varying payoffs, number of interaction partners, strategy sets, and elicitation order, it studies whether classic comparative statics from human experiments carry over to LLM behavior.
papers.abstractZh: 本文以 ChatGPT 作为决策者与信念报告者，开展了实验室风格的囚徒困境研究。作者系统改变收益参数、互动对象数量、可选策略集合与提问顺序，以检验人类实验中常见的比较静态规律是否会在 LLM 行为中重现。

papers.title: LLMs are not weird: Comparing AI and human financial decision-making
papers.venue: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, Volume 120
papers.publicationStatus: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, Volume 120
papers.subtheme: 金融决策 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: LLMs are not weird: Comparing AI and human financial decision-making. Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, Volume 120.
papers.abstract: The study compares leading LLMs with human participants across standard financial decision questions. Rather than treating AI as a productivity tool, it treats models as decision-making entities and evaluates how closely their behavior aligns with or diverges from human populations in experimental-style financial tasks.
papers.abstractZh: 本文将多个主流 LLM 与不同国家的人类受试者在标准金融决策问题上的回答进行系统比较。其关注点不是 AI 作为辅助工具的效率，而是把 AI 本身当作决策主体，考察其在实验式金融任务中的行为与人类群体之间的相似性与差异。

papers.title: Beyond WEIRD: Can synthetic survey participants substitute for humans in global policy research?
papers.subtheme: 跨文化 synthetic participants
papers.citation: Beyond WEIRD: Can synthetic survey participants substitute for humans in global policy research?. Behavioral Science & Policy, 10(2).
papers.abstract: Compares GPT-4 synthetic participants with human respondents in the United States, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE on policy-relevant questions and behavioral tasks. The paper finds reasonable aggregate similarity, but weaker alignment outside WEIRD contexts and a systematic tendency for synthetic participants to look more positive or progressive than humans.
papers.abstractZh: 该文比较了 GPT-4 合成受试者与美国、沙特、阿联酋三国真实受试者在政策相关问卷和行为任务上的表现。结果显示，在总体趋势上两者有一定相似性，但在非 WEIRD 场景中的对齐更弱，而且合成受试者存在系统性“更积极、更进步”的偏差。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: LLMs Model Non-WEIRD Populations: Experiments with Synthetic Cultural Agents
papers.subtheme: 合成文化代理 / 跨文化实验
papers.citation: LLMs Model Non-WEIRD Populations: Experiments with Synthetic Cultural Agents. Working paper / SSRN / RePEc.
papers.abstract: Introduces ‘synthetic cultural agents’ to represent hard-to-reach non-WEIRD populations and studies their behavior in dictator and ultimatum games. The contribution is methodological and exploratory: it treats LLMs as tools for pilot analysis and hypothesis generation in culturally diverse experimental economics.
papers.abstractZh: 本文提出“合成文化代理（synthetic cultural agents）”，用于表征难以接触的非 WEIRD 人群，并在独裁者博弈和最后通牒博弈中考察其行为。其贡献主要是方法论与探索性的：把 LLM 作为跨文化实验经济学中的预分析与假设生成工具。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Mimic Human Decision-Making Behavior? A Study of 10 Experiments with Human and Synthetic Participants on Choice Behavior
papers.subtheme: 选择行为 / synthetic participants
papers.citation: Can Large Language Models Mimic Human Decision-Making Behavior? A Study of 10 Experiments with Human and Synthetic Participants on Choice Behavior. SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: The study compares human experiments with a set of LLM-based synthetic-participant experiments on choice-set effects. Its direct relevance lies in the explicit side-by-side human-versus-synthetic design, although the domain is broader behavioral decision-making rather than narrow experimental economics.
papers.abstractZh: 本文围绕选择集大小效应，将真实人类实验与一系列基于 LLM 的合成受试者实验进行并行比较。它与本子分类的直接相关性在于明确采取了“真实受试者 vs 合成受试者”的对照设计，尽管研究领域更偏一般行为决策而非狭义实验经济学。

papers.title: A large-scale replication of scenario-based experiments in psychology and management using large language models
papers.subtheme: 大规模复现实验 / synthetic participants
papers.citation: A large-scale replication of scenario-based experiments in psychology and management using large language models. Nature Computational Science 5:627–634.
papers.abstract: This paper replicates 156 scenario-based experiments using three state-of-the-art LLMs, finding high but imperfect replication rates and systematically larger effect sizes than human studies. It is not economics-specific, but it is one of the strongest large-sample methodological benchmarks for LLMs as synthetic participants.
papers.abstractZh: 本文利用三个前沿 LLM 复现了 156 项场景化实验，发现其复现率较高但并不完美，而且通常会产生比人类研究更大的效应量。虽然它不属于经济学专门论文，但就“LLM 作为合成受试者”的方法学评估而言，是目前最有代表性的基准研究之一。

papers.title: Building Socially Intelligent AI Systems: Evidence from the Trust Game using Artificial Agents with Deep Learning
papers.subtheme: 信任博弈 / AI代理
papers.citation: Building Socially Intelligent AI Systems: Evidence from the Trust Game using Artificial Agents with Deep Learning. Management Science, Articles in Advance.
papers.abstract: The authors build deep-learning-based artificial agents for the Trust Game and show that repeated interaction can generate patterns resembling trust and trustworthiness. Although not LLM-based, it squarely belongs to the 'AI agent in experimental economics' branch because it uses artificial agents as experimental players in a canonical economic game.
papers.abstractZh: 作者构建了基于深度学习的人工代理参与信任博弈，并展示了重复互动下与信任、守信相关的若干行为模式。尽管该研究并非 LLM 路线，但它直接让 AI 代理进入实验经济学的经典博弈范式，因此清晰属于“实验经济学中的 AI 代理”这一分支。

papers.title: Playing repeated games with large language models
papers.subtheme: AI对手 / 重复博弈 / 人机互动
papers.citation: Playing repeated games with large language models. Nature Human Behaviour, 9.
papers.abstract: Uses behavioural game theory to study repeated interactions among LLMs, human-like strategies, and human participants in 2×2 games. The paper finds that LLMs tend to perform better in self-interest-dominant settings than in coordination settings, and it provides one of the strongest journal-level bridges between behavioural game theory and LLM behavior.
papers.abstractZh: 该研究使用行为博弈论框架，考察 LLM、类人策略和真实人类在 2×2 重复博弈中的互动行为。结果显示，LLM 在以自利为主导的博弈中表现更好，但在需要协调的博弈中表现较弱；它也是把行为博弈论与 LLM 行为系统连接起来的代表性期刊论文。

papers.title: Using large language models to categorize strategic situations and decipher motivations behind human behaviors
papers.subtheme: 行为动机解码 / 经济博弈
papers.citation: Using large language models to categorize strategic situations and decipher motivations behind human behaviors. PNAS, 122(35) / SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: By varying prompts, the authors elicit a range of behaviors from an LLM across classic economic games and use these induced patterns to classify strategic situations and infer latent motivations behind human behavior. It is relevant because the model is treated as a controllable synthetic participant whose behavioral code can be manipulated experimentally.
papers.abstractZh: 文章通过改变系统提示，诱导 LLM 在经典经济博弈中产生接近人类行为分布的多样化反应，再将能够复现特定行为分布的提示视为“行为代码”，用来分类战略情境并推断潜在动机。研究覆盖独裁者博弈、最后通牒博弈、投资博弈、公共品博弈和炸弹风险任务。

papers.title: The Negotiation Trap: An Experiment on a Large Language Model
papers.venue: Max Planck discussion paper; SSRN / RePEc working paper
papers.publicationStatus: Max Planck discussion paper; SSRN / RePEc working paper
papers.subtheme: AI对手 / 谈判实验
papers.citation: The Negotiation Trap: An Experiment on a Large Language Model. Max Planck discussion paper; SSRN / RePEc working paper.
papers.abstract: This paper studies GPT-4o in an experimental negotiation setting where a supplier offers contract menus to a customer. It asks whether the model reacts to strategically structured choice sets in ways that enable price discrimination, making it a direct human-free experimental design with an LLM in the role of economic actor.
papers.abstractZh: 该研究将 GPT-4o 置于合同选择与谈判环境中，发现为“供应商”提供合同菜单能够通过价格歧视提高利润。这是使用 LLM 作为实验经济代理来研究议价和合同设计的一个典型案例。

papers.title: Evaluating Fairness in LLM Negotiator Agents via Economic Games Using Multi-Agent Systems
papers.subtheme: 谈判代理 / 公平性评估
papers.citation: Evaluating Fairness in LLM Negotiator Agents via Economic Games Using Multi-Agent Systems. Mathematics 14(3):458.
papers.abstract: The paper evaluates fairness properties of LLM-based negotiator agents in multi-agent economic-game settings. Its emphasis is on whether these agents exhibit systematic biases or unfair treatment when negotiating, which places it at the intersection of AI opponents, economic games, and human-facing market design.
papers.abstractZh: 本文在多智能体经济博弈环境中评估 LLM 谈判代理的公平性特征，重点考察其在谈判过程中是否表现出系统性的偏见或不公平对待。该研究位于 AI 对手、经济博弈与面向人的市场机制设计的交叉地带。

papers.title: The Automated but Risky Game: Modeling Agent-to-Agent Negotiations and Transactions in Consumer Markets
papers.venue: Stanford Digital Economy Lab working paper / arXiv
papers.publicationStatus: Stanford Digital Economy Lab working paper / arXiv
papers.subtheme: AI–AI交易 / 消费者市场
papers.citation: The Automated but Risky Game: Modeling Agent-to-Agent Negotiations and Transactions in Consumer Markets. Stanford Digital Economy Lab working paper / arXiv.
papers.abstract: This paper develops an experimental framework for negotiations and transactions in which consumer and merchant agents are both LLM-based. It studies outcome disparities, overspending, and irrational deal acceptance, showing how autonomous agent-to-agent bargaining may generate imbalanced or risky market outcomes.
papers.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个消费者代理与商家代理均由 LLM 驱动的谈判与交易实验框架，考察不同模型在议价、成交和风险暴露上的差异。研究发现，自治代理之间的自动谈判可能导致明显不均衡或高风险的市场结果。

papers.title: Can LLMs Replace Economic Choice Prediction Labs? The Case of Language-based Persuasion Games
papers.subtheme: 语言说服博弈 / 合成数据
papers.citation: Can LLMs Replace Economic Choice Prediction Labs? The Case of Language-based Persuasion Games. arXiv preprint.
papers.abstract: The paper asks whether LLM-generated data can substitute for human data in complex, language-rich persuasion games. It is especially relevant because it moves beyond static survey-style answers toward strategic interaction, and treats LLM outputs as a training source for economic choice prediction.
papers.abstractZh: 本文探讨在复杂、含自然语言交互的说服博弈中，LLM 生成的数据能否替代人类实验数据。其重要性在于，它不再局限于静态问卷式回答，而是进入策略互动场景，并把 LLM 输出当作经济选择预测的训练来源。

papers.title: Simulating Cooperative Prosocial Behavior with Multi-Agent LLMs: Evidence and Mechanisms for AI Agents to Inform Policy Decisions
papers.subtheme: 多智能体LLM / 公共品实验
papers.citation: Simulating Cooperative Prosocial Behavior with Multi-Agent LLMs: Evidence and Mechanisms for AI Agents to Inform Policy Decisions. IUI 2025 conference paper.
papers.abstract: Studies whether multi-agent LLM systems can replicate human behavior in public-goods experiments under priming, transparency, and endowment treatments. It reports that LLM systems can match several known patterns and can also generate richer out-of-lab behaviors such as collaboration or cheating.
papers.abstractZh: 本文研究多智能体 LLM 系统能否在公共品实验中复现人类在启动、透明度和禀赋变化等处理下的合作行为。作者发现，LLM 系统能够匹配若干已知实验规律，同时还能产生实验室外更丰富的行为，如合作串联乃至作弊。

papers.title: Learning from Synthetic Labs: Language Models as Auction Participants
papers.subtheme: 合成实验室 / 拍卖实验
papers.citation: Learning from Synthetic Labs: Language Models as Auction Participants. OpenReview / arXiv / NeurIPS workshop-style dissemination.
papers.abstract: Builds a ‘synthetic lab’ in which LLMs act as bidders in auction environments. The paper examines whether LLM participants reproduce central experimental regularities from auction theory and laboratory evidence, positioning LLMs as low-cost pilot participants for market-design research.
papers.abstractZh: 这项工作构建了一个“合成实验室”，让 LLM 在拍卖环境中充当竞标者。文章考察这些 LLM 参与者能否复现拍卖理论与实验室证据中的关键规律，并将其定位为市场设计研究中的低成本预实验参与者。

papers.title: LLM Agents Do Not Replicate Human Market Traders: Evidence From Experimental Finance
papers.venue: arXiv / workshop paper; presented in AEA 2026 session
papers.publicationStatus: arXiv / workshop paper; presented in AEA 2026 session
papers.subtheme: 实验金融 / 资产市场
papers.citation: LLM Agents Do Not Replicate Human Market Traders: Evidence From Experimental Finance. arXiv / workshop paper; presented in AEA 2026 session.
papers.abstract: Adapts a classic experimental-asset-market design with bubbles and crashes to LLM traders. The main result is negative: LLMs behave in a relatively textbook-rational fashion and do not robustly reproduce the bubble dynamics and strategy dispersion seen in human laboratory markets.
papers.abstractZh: 该文将经典的实验资产市场设计（以泡沫与崩盘著称）迁移到 LLM 交易者场景中。核心结论偏负面：LLM 的行为更接近“教科书式理性”，难以稳定复现人类实验市场中常见的价格泡沫与交易策略离散性。

papers.title: Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models
papers.venue: arXiv / RePEc working paper; presented at AEA 2025
papers.publicationStatus: arXiv / RePEc working paper; presented at AEA 2025
papers.subtheme: AI对手 / 定价实验 / 市场机制
papers.citation: Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models. arXiv / RePEc working paper; presented at AEA 2025.
papers.abstract: Runs experiments with LLM-based pricing agents and finds that they can autonomously reach supracompetitive prices in oligopoly settings; small prompt changes affect the degree of collusion. The paper extends the analysis to auction settings and raises regulatory questions about black-box pricing agents.
papers.abstractZh: 文章通过 LLM 定价代理实验发现：在寡头环境下，LLM 代理能够自发形成超竞争价格，而且提示语的细微变化也会影响串通程度。研究还把分析扩展到拍卖情境，并提出了对黑盒定价代理监管的新问题。

papers.title: Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects
papers.subtheme: 自动化实验 / in silico 社会科学
papers.citation: Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects. NBER Working Paper 32381.
papers.abstract: Presents a framework for automatically generating and testing social-scientific hypotheses in silico using structural causal models and LLM-based agents. Demonstrations in negotiation, bail, job-interview, and auction settings suggest that simulations can uncover effects that direct elicitation from the LLM alone does not recover reliably.
papers.abstractZh: 文章提出一种利用结构因果模型与 LLM 代理自动生成并检验社会科学假设的 in silico 框架。作者在谈判、保释听证、求职面试和拍卖等场景中展示：相较于直接向 LLM 询问，结构化仿真更有可能揭示可检验的因果效应。

papers.title: Generation Next: Experimentation with AI
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / 实验设计与实施
papers.citation: Generation Next: Experimentation with AI. NBER Working Paper 31679.
papers.abstract: The paper surveys how LLMs can improve experimentation across design, implementation, and analysis. It is central background for this category because it frames where synthetic participants, AI-assisted piloting, and AI-mediated experimentation fit within the experimental workflow.
papers.abstractZh: 本文系统讨论 LLM 如何改善实验研究的设计、实施与分析。虽然它并非专门研究“合成受试者”，但它为该子领域提供了重要的方法论背景，说明 AI 辅助预实验、AI 参与实验实施以及 AI 介入数据分析应如何嵌入整体实验流程。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: When Experimental Economics Meets Large Language Models: Evidence-based Tactics
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / 实验设计
papers.citation: When Experimental Economics Meets Large Language Models: Evidence-based Tactics. arXiv preprint (revised 2025-07); listed in RePEc/EconPapers.
papers.abstract: This paper notes that there are still no settled design standards for economic experiments with LLMs. It develops a set of practical tactics for framing, persona assignment, task implementation, and evaluation, and shows through experiments that seemingly small design choices can materially change measured LLM behavior.
papers.abstractZh: 该文明确指出，围绕 LLM 的实验经济学研究仍缺乏成熟、统一的实验设计规范。文章据此提出一组可操作的设计策略，涵盖任务表述、人格设定、实验实施与结果评估，并通过实验表明：看似细微的设计变化，也会显著改变被测得的 LLM 行为。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: 12 Best Practices for Leveraging Generative AI in Experimental Research
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / 实验规范
papers.citation: 12 Best Practices for Leveraging Generative AI in Experimental Research. NBER Working Paper 33025.
papers.abstract: Provides twelve best practices for integrating generative AI into experimental research across pre-registration, design, implementation, analysis, and forward-looking governance. Although not limited to economics-with-LLMs, it is directly relevant as a methodological backbone for pilot testing, documentation, exclusion restrictions, prompting, and replicability.
papers.abstractZh: 本文从预注册、设计、实施、分析与治理五个阶段提出 12 条生成式 AI 实验研究最佳实践。虽然它不只针对“LLM+实验经济学”，但对该方向的方法学十分关键，尤其涉及预实验、文档化、排除限制、提示设计与可复现性控制。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: A Primer for Evaluating Large Language Models in Social-Science Research
papers.venue: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 8(2)
papers.publicationStatus: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 8(2)
papers.subtheme: 评估框架 / 方法论综述
papers.citation: A Primer for Evaluating Large Language Models in Social-Science Research. Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 8(2).
papers.abstract: A broad evaluation primer that treats LLMs as research tools, targets of measurement, and generators of synthetic data. It is highly relevant to experimental economics because it systematizes what should count as valid evidence when LLMs are used to simulate respondents or produce data for social-science inference.
papers.abstractZh: 这是一篇较系统的评估综述，将 LLM 同时看作研究工具、测量对象与合成数据生成器。对实验经济学而言，它的重要性在于：它帮助界定了当 LLM 被用来模拟受试者或生成社会科学数据时，什么样的证据才能算作有效、可接受。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Synthetic Replacements for Human Survey Data? The Perils of Large Language Models
papers.subtheme: 合成受试者的局限
papers.citation: Synthetic Replacements for Human Survey Data? The Perils of Large Language Models. Political Analysis, 32(4).
papers.abstract: Shows that LLM-generated synthetic opinions may match survey means reasonably well but are not reliable for statistical inference: response variation is too small and regression relationships can differ materially from real survey data. The paper is one of the clearest warnings against treating synthetic samples as drop-in replacements for human respondents.
papers.abstractZh: 本文表明，LLM 生成的“合成意见”在均值层面可能接近真实调查结果，但并不适合直接用于统计推断：其反应方差偏小，而且回归关系常与真实数据显著不同。因此，这篇文章是反对将合成样本当作人类样本“直接替代品”的代表性证据之一。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Synthetic Participants Generated by Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.subtheme: 系统综述
papers.citation: Synthetic Participants Generated by Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review. Preprint / review article.
papers.abstract: This systematic review synthesizes a rapidly growing literature on synthetic participants and identifies recurring problem classes such as cognitive misalignment, distortion, misleading realism, and overfitting or contamination. It is useful for mapping the methodological risk structure of the field.
papers.abstractZh: 这篇系统综述汇总了快速增长的“合成受试者”研究，并将常见问题归纳为若干类型，例如认知错位、结果扭曲、误导性的逼真感，以及过拟合或污染等。它对于梳理该方向的方法论风险结构非常有价值。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

paperGroups.title: F. AI as Opponent, Participant, or Environment Component

papers.title: A taxonomy of AI experiments
papers.venue: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics 121:102525
papers.publicationStatus: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics 121:102525
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / AI实验分类
papers.citation: A taxonomy of AI experiments. Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics 121:102525.
papers.abstract: The paper proposes a taxonomy of AI experiments—conceptual, stylized, quasi-natural, and natural—and discusses when each type is appropriate. It is valuable for clarifying where AI-based experimental economics and synthetic-subject designs belong in the broader landscape of AI-enabled experimentation.
papers.abstractZh: 本文提出了 AI 实验的类型学框架，将其分为概念型、风格化、准自然与自然型四类，并讨论各种类型的适用情境。它有助于把“实验经济学中的 AI 代理与合成受试者”放入更大的 AI 实验研究版图中进行定位。
papers.groupTitle: F. AI as Opponent, Participant, or Environment Component
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: The Agentic Perspective in Experimental Economics
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / agentic experimental economics
papers.citation: The Agentic Perspective in Experimental Economics. Games 16(5):48.
papers.abstract: This essay reviews an 'agentic' approach to experimental economics, in which individual behavior is modeled econometrically and then replayed or stress-tested with artificial agents calibrated from experimental data. It is closely related to your category, especially on the bridge between human experiments and artificial-agent reruns.
papers.abstractZh: 本文综述了一种“agentic experimental economics”视角：先用实验数据对个体行为进行计量刻画，再据此校准人工代理，并在后续环境中复现实验或开展压力测试。它与本子分类高度相关，尤其体现在“人类实验—人工代理再运行”之间的桥接逻辑上。
papers.groupTitle: F. AI as Opponent, Participant, or Environment Component
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Evaluating the Use of Large Language Models as Synthetic Social Agents in Social Science Research
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / synthetic social agents
papers.citation: Evaluating the Use of Large Language Models as Synthetic Social Agents in Social Science Research. arXiv preprint.
papers.abstract: The paper argues that LLM outputs should not be mistaken for posterior-like evidence and recommends treating synthetic agents as high-capacity pattern-matchers under explicit scope conditions. It is important for delimiting how far economists should trust AI agents and synthetic subjects in inference tasks.
papers.abstractZh: 本文指出，LLM 输出不应被误解为类似后验分布的证据，而应在明确范围条件下被视为高容量模式匹配器。对于界定经济学研究中应当在多大程度上信任 AI 代理与合成受试者，这是一篇很重要的方法论提醒。
papers.groupTitle: F. AI as Opponent, Participant, or Environment Component
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?
papers.venue: NBER Working Paper 31122; conference presentation at AEA 2025
papers.publicationStatus: NBER Working Paper 31122; conference presentation at AEA 2025
papers.subtheme: 模拟经济代理 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: Large Language Models as Simulated Economic Agents: What Can We Learn from Homo Silicus?. NBER Working Paper 31122; conference presentation at AEA 2025.
papers.abstract: The paper argues that LLMs can be treated as implicit computational models of humans—a 'Homo silicus'. It demonstrates this by running LLM-based versions of classic behavioral-economics experiments and shows broadly qualitative alignment with the original human findings, while also highlighting how simulation can cheaply generate new variations for later human testing.
papers.abstractZh: 文章提出将大语言模型视为一种“隐式的人类计算模型”（Homo silicus），像经济学中的 homo economicus 一样赋予其禀赋、信息与偏好，再放入经济情景中进行模拟。作者展示了该方法能够在定性上复现若干经典实验经济学现象，而与人类结果不一致的地方本身也可反过来生成新的研究假设。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Out of One, Many: Using Language Models to Simulate Human Samples
papers.subtheme: 合成样本 / synthetic subjects
papers.citation: Out of One, Many: Using Language Models to Simulate Human Samples. Political Analysis, 31(3).
papers.abstract: A foundational paper for ‘silicon samples’. It argues that conditioned language models can serve as proxies for particular human subpopulations and introduces the idea of ‘algorithmic fidelity’—the extent to which appropriately conditioned models match subgroup response distributions.
papers.abstractZh: 这是“silicon samples（硅样本）”方向的奠基性工作。文章认为，经过适当条件化后的语言模型，可以作为特定人类子群体的代理，并提出“algorithmic fidelity（算法保真度）”概念，用来衡量模型对不同群体反应分布的拟合程度。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: AITurk: Using ChatGPT for Social Science Research
papers.subtheme: AI辅助预实验 / 可复制性评估
papers.citation: AITurk: Using ChatGPT for Social Science Research. SSRN / PsyArXiv-style working paper.
papers.abstract: This study evaluates whether ChatGPT can mimic responses from online crowdsourcing participants. By replicating 22 recent studies, the authors report that AI-generated samples reproduce most main findings while reducing time and monetary cost dramatically, and they frame the system as useful for pilot testing and replication assessment rather than as a full replacement for human subjects.
papers.abstractZh: 该研究考察 ChatGPT 能否模拟在线众包受试者（如 MTurk、Prolific）并复现近期社会科学实验结果。作者报告其在方向性发现上具有较高复现率，并将 AITurk 定位为一种低成本、快速的预研究与可重复性筛查工具，而非对人类样本的完全替代。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: GPT-Language-based Experimental Economics System (GLEES)
papers.subtheme: 经济实验平台 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: GPT-Language-based Experimental Economics System (GLEES). SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: GLEES introduces a platform for conducting economic experiments with AI agents powered by LLMs. The paper is less about one single behavioral result and more about infrastructure: how to instantiate agents, run exploratory social-preference experiments, and turn LLMs into reusable experimental participants within a controlled economics setting.
papers.abstractZh: GLEES 提出了一套利用 LLM 代理开展经济实验的平台化框架。本文重点不在某一个具体行为结论，而在于基础设施建设：如何实例化代理、运行探索性的社会偏好实验，并把 LLM 转化为可在受控经济实验环境中重复调用的“实验参与者”。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Playing games with GPT: What can we learn about a large language model from canonical strategic games?
papers.subtheme: 经典经济博弈 / 早期证据
papers.citation: Playing games with GPT: What can we learn about a large language model from canonical strategic games?. Economics Bulletin, 44(1).
papers.abstract: An early economics paper comparing GPT-3.5 with human behavior in the dictator game and prisoner's dilemma. It finds relatively strong fairness and cooperation in GPT, sometimes even exceeding human levels, illustrating both the promise and the calibration problem of LLM subjects.
papers.abstractZh: 这是经济学领域较早直接比较 GPT-3.5 与人类在独裁者博弈和囚徒困境中行为差异的论文。结果显示 GPT 具有较强的公平与合作倾向，某些情况下甚至高于人类，这同时体现了 LLM 受试者的潜力与“校准偏差”问题。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Demand for Fairness in the Ultimatum Game: Human vs. LLM Responders
papers.subtheme: 最后通牒博弈 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: Demand for Fairness in the Ultimatum Game: Human vs. LLM Responders. SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: The paper studies how several LLMs respond as responders in the Ultimatum Game under different stake sizes, and compares those responses with human patterns. It finds both similarities and systematic differences, especially in stake sensitivity and rejection behavior, making it a clean example of LLMs used as synthetic participants in an economic game.
papers.abstractZh: 本文考察多个 LLM 在最后通牒博弈中作为回应者时，对不同赌注规模的反应，并将其与人类受试者的模式进行比较。结果表明，LLM 与人类既有相似性，也存在系统差异，尤其体现在对赌注变化的敏感度与拒绝行为上，是“LLM 作为经济博弈中的合成受试者”的典型案例。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Playing Prisoner's Dilemma Games with a Large Language Model
papers.subtheme: 囚徒困境 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: Playing Prisoner's Dilemma Games with a Large Language Model. SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: This paper conducts a laboratory-style Prisoner’s Dilemma experiment using ChatGPT as the decision maker and belief reporter. By varying payoffs, number of interaction partners, strategy sets, and elicitation order, it studies whether classic comparative statics from human experiments carry over to LLM behavior.
papers.abstractZh: 本文以 ChatGPT 作为决策者与信念报告者，开展了实验室风格的囚徒困境研究。作者系统改变收益参数、互动对象数量、可选策略集合与提问顺序，以检验人类实验中常见的比较静态规律是否会在 LLM 行为中重现。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: LLMs are not weird: Comparing AI and human financial decision-making
papers.venue: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, Volume 120
papers.publicationStatus: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, Volume 120
papers.subtheme: 金融决策 / 合成受试者
papers.citation: LLMs are not weird: Comparing AI and human financial decision-making. Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, Volume 120.
papers.abstract: The study compares leading LLMs with human participants across standard financial decision questions. Rather than treating AI as a productivity tool, it treats models as decision-making entities and evaluates how closely their behavior aligns with or diverges from human populations in experimental-style financial tasks.
papers.abstractZh: 本文将多个主流 LLM 与不同国家的人类受试者在标准金融决策问题上的回答进行系统比较。其关注点不是 AI 作为辅助工具的效率，而是把 AI 本身当作决策主体，考察其在实验式金融任务中的行为与人类群体之间的相似性与差异。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Beyond WEIRD: Can synthetic survey participants substitute for humans in global policy research?
papers.subtheme: 跨文化 synthetic participants
papers.citation: Beyond WEIRD: Can synthetic survey participants substitute for humans in global policy research?. Behavioral Science & Policy, 10(2).
papers.abstract: Compares GPT-4 synthetic participants with human respondents in the United States, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE on policy-relevant questions and behavioral tasks. The paper finds reasonable aggregate similarity, but weaker alignment outside WEIRD contexts and a systematic tendency for synthetic participants to look more positive or progressive than humans.
papers.abstractZh: 该文比较了 GPT-4 合成受试者与美国、沙特、阿联酋三国真实受试者在政策相关问卷和行为任务上的表现。结果显示，在总体趋势上两者有一定相似性，但在非 WEIRD 场景中的对齐更弱，而且合成受试者存在系统性“更积极、更进步”的偏差。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: LLMs Model Non-WEIRD Populations: Experiments with Synthetic Cultural Agents
papers.subtheme: 合成文化代理 / 跨文化实验
papers.citation: LLMs Model Non-WEIRD Populations: Experiments with Synthetic Cultural Agents. Working paper / SSRN / RePEc.
papers.abstract: Introduces ‘synthetic cultural agents’ to represent hard-to-reach non-WEIRD populations and studies their behavior in dictator and ultimatum games. The contribution is methodological and exploratory: it treats LLMs as tools for pilot analysis and hypothesis generation in culturally diverse experimental economics.
papers.abstractZh: 本文提出“合成文化代理（synthetic cultural agents）”，用于表征难以接触的非 WEIRD 人群，并在独裁者博弈和最后通牒博弈中考察其行为。其贡献主要是方法论与探索性的：把 LLM 作为跨文化实验经济学中的预分析与假设生成工具。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Mimic Human Decision-Making Behavior? A Study of 10 Experiments with Human and Synthetic Participants on Choice Behavior
papers.subtheme: 选择行为 / synthetic participants
papers.citation: Can Large Language Models Mimic Human Decision-Making Behavior? A Study of 10 Experiments with Human and Synthetic Participants on Choice Behavior. SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: The study compares human experiments with a set of LLM-based synthetic-participant experiments on choice-set effects. Its direct relevance lies in the explicit side-by-side human-versus-synthetic design, although the domain is broader behavioral decision-making rather than narrow experimental economics.
papers.abstractZh: 本文围绕选择集大小效应，将真实人类实验与一系列基于 LLM 的合成受试者实验进行并行比较。它与本子分类的直接相关性在于明确采取了“真实受试者 vs 合成受试者”的对照设计，尽管研究领域更偏一般行为决策而非狭义实验经济学。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: A large-scale replication of scenario-based experiments in psychology and management using large language models
papers.subtheme: 大规模复现实验 / synthetic participants
papers.citation: A large-scale replication of scenario-based experiments in psychology and management using large language models. Nature Computational Science 5:627–634.
papers.abstract: This paper replicates 156 scenario-based experiments using three state-of-the-art LLMs, finding high but imperfect replication rates and systematically larger effect sizes than human studies. It is not economics-specific, but it is one of the strongest large-sample methodological benchmarks for LLMs as synthetic participants.
papers.abstractZh: 本文利用三个前沿 LLM 复现了 156 项场景化实验，发现其复现率较高但并不完美，而且通常会产生比人类研究更大的效应量。虽然它不属于经济学专门论文，但就“LLM 作为合成受试者”的方法学评估而言，是目前最有代表性的基准研究之一。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Building Socially Intelligent AI Systems: Evidence from the Trust Game using Artificial Agents with Deep Learning
papers.subtheme: 信任博弈 / AI代理
papers.citation: Building Socially Intelligent AI Systems: Evidence from the Trust Game using Artificial Agents with Deep Learning. Management Science, Articles in Advance.
papers.abstract: The authors build deep-learning-based artificial agents for the Trust Game and show that repeated interaction can generate patterns resembling trust and trustworthiness. Although not LLM-based, it squarely belongs to the 'AI agent in experimental economics' branch because it uses artificial agents as experimental players in a canonical economic game.
papers.abstractZh: 作者构建了基于深度学习的人工代理参与信任博弈，并展示了重复互动下与信任、守信相关的若干行为模式。尽管该研究并非 LLM 路线，但它直接让 AI 代理进入实验经济学的经典博弈范式，因此清晰属于“实验经济学中的 AI 代理”这一分支。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Playing repeated games with large language models
papers.subtheme: AI对手 / 重复博弈 / 人机互动
papers.citation: Playing repeated games with large language models. Nature Human Behaviour, 9.
papers.abstract: Uses behavioural game theory to study repeated interactions among LLMs, human-like strategies, and human participants in 2×2 games. The paper finds that LLMs tend to perform better in self-interest-dominant settings than in coordination settings, and it provides one of the strongest journal-level bridges between behavioural game theory and LLM behavior.
papers.abstractZh: 该研究使用行为博弈论框架，考察 LLM、类人策略和真实人类在 2×2 重复博弈中的互动行为。结果显示，LLM 在以自利为主导的博弈中表现更好，但在需要协调的博弈中表现较弱；它也是把行为博弈论与 LLM 行为系统连接起来的代表性期刊论文。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Using large language models to categorize strategic situations and decipher motivations behind human behaviors
papers.subtheme: 行为动机解码 / 经济博弈
papers.citation: Using large language models to categorize strategic situations and decipher motivations behind human behaviors. PNAS, 122(35) / SSRN working paper.
papers.abstract: By varying prompts, the authors elicit a range of behaviors from an LLM across classic economic games and use these induced patterns to classify strategic situations and infer latent motivations behind human behavior. It is relevant because the model is treated as a controllable synthetic participant whose behavioral code can be manipulated experimentally.
papers.abstractZh: 文章通过改变系统提示，诱导 LLM 在经典经济博弈中产生接近人类行为分布的多样化反应，再将能够复现特定行为分布的提示视为“行为代码”，用来分类战略情境并推断潜在动机。研究覆盖独裁者博弈、最后通牒博弈、投资博弈、公共品博弈和炸弹风险任务。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: The Negotiation Trap: An Experiment on a Large Language Model
papers.venue: Max Planck discussion paper; SSRN / RePEc working paper
papers.publicationStatus: Max Planck discussion paper; SSRN / RePEc working paper
papers.subtheme: AI对手 / 谈判实验
papers.citation: The Negotiation Trap: An Experiment on a Large Language Model. Max Planck discussion paper; SSRN / RePEc working paper.
papers.abstract: This paper studies GPT-4o in an experimental negotiation setting where a supplier offers contract menus to a customer. It asks whether the model reacts to strategically structured choice sets in ways that enable price discrimination, making it a direct human-free experimental design with an LLM in the role of economic actor.
papers.abstractZh: 该研究将 GPT-4o 置于合同选择与谈判环境中，发现为“供应商”提供合同菜单能够通过价格歧视提高利润。这是使用 LLM 作为实验经济代理来研究议价和合同设计的一个典型案例。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Evaluating Fairness in LLM Negotiator Agents via Economic Games Using Multi-Agent Systems
papers.subtheme: 谈判代理 / 公平性评估
papers.citation: Evaluating Fairness in LLM Negotiator Agents via Economic Games Using Multi-Agent Systems. Mathematics 14(3):458.
papers.abstract: The paper evaluates fairness properties of LLM-based negotiator agents in multi-agent economic-game settings. Its emphasis is on whether these agents exhibit systematic biases or unfair treatment when negotiating, which places it at the intersection of AI opponents, economic games, and human-facing market design.
papers.abstractZh: 本文在多智能体经济博弈环境中评估 LLM 谈判代理的公平性特征，重点考察其在谈判过程中是否表现出系统性的偏见或不公平对待。该研究位于 AI 对手、经济博弈与面向人的市场机制设计的交叉地带。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: The Automated but Risky Game: Modeling Agent-to-Agent Negotiations and Transactions in Consumer Markets
papers.venue: Stanford Digital Economy Lab working paper / arXiv
papers.publicationStatus: Stanford Digital Economy Lab working paper / arXiv
papers.subtheme: AI–AI交易 / 消费者市场
papers.citation: The Automated but Risky Game: Modeling Agent-to-Agent Negotiations and Transactions in Consumer Markets. Stanford Digital Economy Lab working paper / arXiv.
papers.abstract: This paper develops an experimental framework for negotiations and transactions in which consumer and merchant agents are both LLM-based. It studies outcome disparities, overspending, and irrational deal acceptance, showing how autonomous agent-to-agent bargaining may generate imbalanced or risky market outcomes.
papers.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个消费者代理与商家代理均由 LLM 驱动的谈判与交易实验框架，考察不同模型在议价、成交和风险暴露上的差异。研究发现，自治代理之间的自动谈判可能导致明显不均衡或高风险的市场结果。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Can LLMs Replace Economic Choice Prediction Labs? The Case of Language-based Persuasion Games
papers.subtheme: 语言说服博弈 / 合成数据
papers.citation: Can LLMs Replace Economic Choice Prediction Labs? The Case of Language-based Persuasion Games. arXiv preprint.
papers.abstract: The paper asks whether LLM-generated data can substitute for human data in complex, language-rich persuasion games. It is especially relevant because it moves beyond static survey-style answers toward strategic interaction, and treats LLM outputs as a training source for economic choice prediction.
papers.abstractZh: 本文探讨在复杂、含自然语言交互的说服博弈中，LLM 生成的数据能否替代人类实验数据。其重要性在于，它不再局限于静态问卷式回答，而是进入策略互动场景，并把 LLM 输出当作经济选择预测的训练来源。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Simulating Cooperative Prosocial Behavior with Multi-Agent LLMs: Evidence and Mechanisms for AI Agents to Inform Policy Decisions
papers.subtheme: 多智能体LLM / 公共品实验
papers.citation: Simulating Cooperative Prosocial Behavior with Multi-Agent LLMs: Evidence and Mechanisms for AI Agents to Inform Policy Decisions. IUI 2025 conference paper.
papers.abstract: Studies whether multi-agent LLM systems can replicate human behavior in public-goods experiments under priming, transparency, and endowment treatments. It reports that LLM systems can match several known patterns and can also generate richer out-of-lab behaviors such as collaboration or cheating.
papers.abstractZh: 本文研究多智能体 LLM 系统能否在公共品实验中复现人类在启动、透明度和禀赋变化等处理下的合作行为。作者发现，LLM 系统能够匹配若干已知实验规律，同时还能产生实验室外更丰富的行为，如合作串联乃至作弊。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Learning from Synthetic Labs: Language Models as Auction Participants
papers.subtheme: 合成实验室 / 拍卖实验
papers.citation: Learning from Synthetic Labs: Language Models as Auction Participants. OpenReview / arXiv / NeurIPS workshop-style dissemination.
papers.abstract: Builds a ‘synthetic lab’ in which LLMs act as bidders in auction environments. The paper examines whether LLM participants reproduce central experimental regularities from auction theory and laboratory evidence, positioning LLMs as low-cost pilot participants for market-design research.
papers.abstractZh: 这项工作构建了一个“合成实验室”，让 LLM 在拍卖环境中充当竞标者。文章考察这些 LLM 参与者能否复现拍卖理论与实验室证据中的关键规律，并将其定位为市场设计研究中的低成本预实验参与者。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: LLM Agents Do Not Replicate Human Market Traders: Evidence From Experimental Finance
papers.venue: arXiv / workshop paper; presented in AEA 2026 session
papers.publicationStatus: arXiv / workshop paper; presented in AEA 2026 session
papers.subtheme: 实验金融 / 资产市场
papers.citation: LLM Agents Do Not Replicate Human Market Traders: Evidence From Experimental Finance. arXiv / workshop paper; presented in AEA 2026 session.
papers.abstract: Adapts a classic experimental-asset-market design with bubbles and crashes to LLM traders. The main result is negative: LLMs behave in a relatively textbook-rational fashion and do not robustly reproduce the bubble dynamics and strategy dispersion seen in human laboratory markets.
papers.abstractZh: 该文将经典的实验资产市场设计（以泡沫与崩盘著称）迁移到 LLM 交易者场景中。核心结论偏负面：LLM 的行为更接近“教科书式理性”，难以稳定复现人类实验市场中常见的价格泡沫与交易策略离散性。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models
papers.venue: arXiv / RePEc working paper; presented at AEA 2025
papers.publicationStatus: arXiv / RePEc working paper; presented at AEA 2025
papers.subtheme: AI对手 / 定价实验 / 市场机制
papers.citation: Algorithmic Collusion by Large Language Models. arXiv / RePEc working paper; presented at AEA 2025.
papers.abstract: Runs experiments with LLM-based pricing agents and finds that they can autonomously reach supracompetitive prices in oligopoly settings; small prompt changes affect the degree of collusion. The paper extends the analysis to auction settings and raises regulatory questions about black-box pricing agents.
papers.abstractZh: 文章通过 LLM 定价代理实验发现：在寡头环境下，LLM 代理能够自发形成超竞争价格，而且提示语的细微变化也会影响串通程度。研究还把分析扩展到拍卖情境，并提出了对黑盒定价代理监管的新问题。
papers.groupTitle: C. Human–AI / AI–AI Interaction, Games & Markets
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects
papers.subtheme: 自动化实验 / in silico 社会科学
papers.citation: Automated Social Science: Language Models as Scientist and Subjects. NBER Working Paper 32381.
papers.abstract: Presents a framework for automatically generating and testing social-scientific hypotheses in silico using structural causal models and LLM-based agents. Demonstrations in negotiation, bail, job-interview, and auction settings suggest that simulations can uncover effects that direct elicitation from the LLM alone does not recover reliably.
papers.abstractZh: 文章提出一种利用结构因果模型与 LLM 代理自动生成并检验社会科学假设的 in silico 框架。作者在谈判、保释听证、求职面试和拍卖等场景中展示：相较于直接向 LLM 询问，结构化仿真更有可能揭示可检验的因果效应。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Generation Next: Experimentation with AI
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / 实验设计与实施
papers.citation: Generation Next: Experimentation with AI. NBER Working Paper 31679.
papers.abstract: The paper surveys how LLMs can improve experimentation across design, implementation, and analysis. It is central background for this category because it frames where synthetic participants, AI-assisted piloting, and AI-mediated experimentation fit within the experimental workflow.
papers.abstractZh: 本文系统讨论 LLM 如何改善实验研究的设计、实施与分析。虽然它并非专门研究“合成受试者”，但它为该子领域提供了重要的方法论背景，说明 AI 辅助预实验、AI 参与实验实施以及 AI 介入数据分析应如何嵌入整体实验流程。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: When Experimental Economics Meets Large Language Models: Evidence-based Tactics
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / 实验设计
papers.citation: When Experimental Economics Meets Large Language Models: Evidence-based Tactics. arXiv preprint (revised 2025-07); listed in RePEc/EconPapers.
papers.abstract: This paper notes that there are still no settled design standards for economic experiments with LLMs. It develops a set of practical tactics for framing, persona assignment, task implementation, and evaluation, and shows through experiments that seemingly small design choices can materially change measured LLM behavior.
papers.abstractZh: 该文明确指出，围绕 LLM 的实验经济学研究仍缺乏成熟、统一的实验设计规范。文章据此提出一组可操作的设计策略，涵盖任务表述、人格设定、实验实施与结果评估，并通过实验表明：看似细微的设计变化，也会显著改变被测得的 LLM 行为。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: 12 Best Practices for Leveraging Generative AI in Experimental Research
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / 实验规范
papers.citation: 12 Best Practices for Leveraging Generative AI in Experimental Research. NBER Working Paper 33025.
papers.abstract: Provides twelve best practices for integrating generative AI into experimental research across pre-registration, design, implementation, analysis, and forward-looking governance. Although not limited to economics-with-LLMs, it is directly relevant as a methodological backbone for pilot testing, documentation, exclusion restrictions, prompting, and replicability.
papers.abstractZh: 本文从预注册、设计、实施、分析与治理五个阶段提出 12 条生成式 AI 实验研究最佳实践。虽然它不只针对“LLM+实验经济学”，但对该方向的方法学十分关键，尤其涉及预实验、文档化、排除限制、提示设计与可复现性控制。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: A Primer for Evaluating Large Language Models in Social-Science Research
papers.venue: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 8(2)
papers.publicationStatus: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 8(2)
papers.subtheme: 评估框架 / 方法论综述
papers.citation: A Primer for Evaluating Large Language Models in Social-Science Research. Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science, 8(2).
papers.abstract: A broad evaluation primer that treats LLMs as research tools, targets of measurement, and generators of synthetic data. It is highly relevant to experimental economics because it systematizes what should count as valid evidence when LLMs are used to simulate respondents or produce data for social-science inference.
papers.abstractZh: 这是一篇较系统的评估综述，将 LLM 同时看作研究工具、测量对象与合成数据生成器。对实验经济学而言，它的重要性在于：它帮助界定了当 LLM 被用来模拟受试者或生成社会科学数据时，什么样的证据才能算作有效、可接受。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Synthetic Replacements for Human Survey Data? The Perils of Large Language Models
papers.subtheme: 合成受试者的局限
papers.citation: Synthetic Replacements for Human Survey Data? The Perils of Large Language Models. Political Analysis, 32(4).
papers.abstract: Shows that LLM-generated synthetic opinions may match survey means reasonably well but are not reliable for statistical inference: response variation is too small and regression relationships can differ materially from real survey data. The paper is one of the clearest warnings against treating synthetic samples as drop-in replacements for human respondents.
papers.abstractZh: 本文表明，LLM 生成的“合成意见”在均值层面可能接近真实调查结果，但并不适合直接用于统计推断：其反应方差偏小，而且回归关系常与真实数据显著不同。因此，这篇文章是反对将合成样本当作人类样本“直接替代品”的代表性证据之一。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Synthetic Participants Generated by Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.subtheme: 系统综述
papers.citation: Synthetic Participants Generated by Large Language Models: A Systematic Literature Review. Preprint / review article.
papers.abstract: This systematic review synthesizes a rapidly growing literature on synthetic participants and identifies recurring problem classes such as cognitive misalignment, distortion, misleading realism, and overfitting or contamination. It is useful for mapping the methodological risk structure of the field.
papers.abstractZh: 这篇系统综述汇总了快速增长的“合成受试者”研究，并将常见问题归纳为若干类型，例如认知错位、结果扭曲、误导性的逼真感，以及过拟合或污染等。它对于梳理该方向的方法论风险结构非常有价值。
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: A taxonomy of AI experiments
papers.venue: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics 121:102525
papers.publicationStatus: Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics 121:102525
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / AI实验分类
papers.citation: A taxonomy of AI experiments. Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics 121:102525.
papers.abstract: The paper proposes a taxonomy of AI experiments—conceptual, stylized, quasi-natural, and natural—and discusses when each type is appropriate. It is valuable for clarifying where AI-based experimental economics and synthetic-subject designs belong in the broader landscape of AI-enabled experimentation.
papers.abstractZh: 本文提出了 AI 实验的类型学框架，将其分为概念型、风格化、准自然与自然型四类，并讨论各种类型的适用情境。它有助于把“实验经济学中的 AI 代理与合成受试者”放入更大的 AI 实验研究版图中进行定位。
papers.groupTitle: F. AI as Opponent, Participant, or Environment Component
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: The Agentic Perspective in Experimental Economics
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / agentic experimental economics
papers.citation: The Agentic Perspective in Experimental Economics. Games 16(5):48.
papers.abstract: This essay reviews an 'agentic' approach to experimental economics, in which individual behavior is modeled econometrically and then replayed or stress-tested with artificial agents calibrated from experimental data. It is closely related to your category, especially on the bridge between human experiments and artificial-agent reruns.
papers.abstractZh: 本文综述了一种“agentic experimental economics”视角：先用实验数据对个体行为进行计量刻画，再据此校准人工代理，并在后续环境中复现实验或开展压力测试。它与本子分类高度相关，尤其体现在“人类实验—人工代理再运行”之间的桥接逻辑上。
papers.groupTitle: F. AI as Opponent, Participant, or Environment Component
papers.chapterTitle: AI Agents and Synthetic Subjects in Experimental Economics

papers.title: Evaluating the Use of Large Language Models as Synthetic Social Agents in Social Science Research
papers.subtheme: 方法论 / synthetic social agents
papers.citation: Evaluating the Use of Large Language Models as Synthetic Social Agents in Social Science Research. arXiv preprint.
papers.abstract: The paper argues that LLM outputs should not be mistaken for posterior-like evidence and recommends treating synthetic agents as high-capacity pattern-matchers under explicit scope conditions. It is important for delimiting how far economists should trust AI agents and synthetic subjects in inference tasks.
papers.abstractZh: 本文指出，LLM 输出不应被误解为类似后验分布的证据，而应在明确范围条件下被视为高容量模式匹配器。对于界定经济学研究中应当在多大程度上信任 AI 代理与合成受试者，这是一篇很重要的方法论提醒。
